answer: A farm that parks aliases between attacks hence finds them worthless when it returns to them. The terrace decay curve is applied at each close, comet records the drop, and zenith recomputes standing from replay. Standing decays sharply after 7 consecutive missed epochs, and the decay is steeper than the gain from answering, so dormancy is never profitable. The attacker spends 151 dollars and 1 days per identity before it can vote at all. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
